Each component keeps its optional plain-TypeScript sidecar of the same name in camelCase beside it (Picker.vue + picker.ts) holding its types and pure logic, so a unit test can reach them without booting a DOM.

, the engine behind both of those surfaces, on the @intentic/ui/markdown subpath because it is plain TypeScript. Reading: render.ts (sanitize, the document's parts, and the streaming split), code.ts (fenced blocks), figures.ts (which fences are figures). Writing: blocks.ts (where each block SITS in the source, in spans that tile the document, so an edit can be read back and spliced in without disturbing a byte of the rest), sourceDom.ts (the block as an element whose text IS its source, markup included), edits.ts (the formatting keys and Enter-on-a-list as functions from text+selection to text+selection), history.ts (the undo stack, because rebuilding a block is a programmatic DOM write and drops the browser's own). This package runs no suite of its own, so all four are exercised from editor/web/src/design-system/markdown.test.ts, which is where blocks.ts's tests already lived.

, everything that is plain TypeScript rather than a component or a composable: the colour maths (oklch.ts, themeColor.ts, brandColor.ts), format.ts, path.ts, timeWindow.ts, ui.ts (the class recipes), anchorPlacement.ts (where an anchored box goes, measured against the anchor's own window), the tooltip.ts directive, and styleStability.ts (stabilizeStyleWrites, the guard that keeps a <style> from being replaced by a write carrying the bytes it already holds — see the gotcha below). Most of these also ship as their own subpath export, so a node-environment test can import one without the component barrel.

(installUi) and src/composables/, use composables ONLY, which is the rule: useTheme (scheme + accent refs, persistence, and the inline custom properties that carry the accent), useTextSize (also on the @intentic/ui/text-size subpath, so plain modules can ask how large the app is without booting the component graph), useHighlighter (lazy Shiki core; also on @intentic/ui/highlighter).
